en-US.description: Desktop app for switching accounts across WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy IDE/CLI, and VS Code / JetBrains CodeBuddy plugins, with credit and token usage monitoring.
en-US.longDescription: WB-Switch-Plus manages multiple WorkBuddy and CodeBuddy accounts in one desktop app, supporting both the China and International editions of every client, with one-click switching, session copy, and cross-account session sync. It monitors credit balances and expiry dates, tracks token usage with trends and heatmaps, and can rotate the CLI's startup account to the one with the most remaining credit. It also ships a local OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible reverse proxy with multi-key distribution built on an account pool.

zh-CN.description: WorkBuddy、CodeBuddy IDE、CodeBuddy CLI 与 VS Code / JetBrains CodeBuddy 插件的账号切换桌面应用，各端均支持国内版/国际版，附积分到期与 Token 用量监控。
zh-CN.longDescription: WB-Switch-Plus 在一个桌面应用中管理多个 WorkBuddy 与 CodeBuddy 账号，覆盖各客户端的国内版/国际版，支持一键切换、会话复制与跨账号会话同步。它提供积分余额与到期监控、Token 用量趋势与热力图统计，并可自动将 CLI 启动账号轮换为剩余积分最多的账号。应用还内置一个本地 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容反代，基于账号池实现多 Key 分发。
zh-CN.name: WB-Switch-Plus

网页端
